svg.title: Exact-composition sequence patterns and an illustrative interchain B-contact topology
svg.desc: Schematic, not simulation data. Panel A: dispersed and blocky chains both contain 40 beads, 28 teal A and 12 orange B. Panel B: three continuous chains with the same composition have central B segments close together and A tails fanning outward. Solid lines are backbone bonds; short purple dashes illustrate interchain contacts.
